rules: Each replay receives an independent status: ready, blocked, failed, or skipped_by_policy.
A blocked replay must not be opened, hashed, copied, or parsed.
A parse failure must stop that replay without recovery, skip, placeholder, or continuation.
A schema or policy failure blocks that artifact class for that replay.
Batch-level success requires all required replay entries to pass their requested mode.
Partial success is allowed only if explicitly reported as partial and no failed replay emits silent artifacts.
Failure of one replay must not force real emission for another replay unless the batch manifest declares independent-safe emission.
